Odisha Police Constable Recruitment 2026 application process has started for 7,268 vacancies across seven posts. Eligible candidates can apply online at ousssc.odisha.gov.in till November 12, 2026. Check this article for eligibility criteria, age limit, vacancy distribution, important dates and direct application link here.
OUSSSC opened online applications for 7,268 vacancies on October 23, 2026.
The application deadline is November 12, 2026; fee payment by November 13, 2026.
Vacancies include Constable, Firefighter, and Driver posts at below graduate level.
Odisha Police Constable Recruitment 2026: The Odisha Uniformed Services Staff Selection Commission (OUSSSC) has officially started the online application process for the Combined Uniformed Services (Below Graduate Level) Examination 2026 on October 23, 2026 . Through this recruitment the commission will fill 7,268 vacancies across seven posts including Constable (Civil), Constable (Communication), Constable OISF, Firefighter and Driver. Eligible and interested candidates can submit their applications through the official website at ousssc.odisha.gov.in. The registration window will remain till November 12, 2026. Applications would be accepted only through the online mode. The last date to submit and pay the application fees is November 13, 2026.
